_comment: Copy to feldd_cc.config.json to customize. Anything you omit falls back to the daemon defaults. The setup wizard (WIZARD.md) writes this for you.

buttons._comment: Each value is a list of tmux send-keys args, or {"shell": "a command"}, or null = do nothing. Track 1-4 are not listed: in multi mode they select the session; in single mode they are unused.
buttons._nudge_recipe: Dangerous-mode 'keep going' button: set play (or vol_plus) to ["continue", "Enter"] to type a word + Enter and push a stopped agent onward. Keep a phrase as ONE string; avoid bare tmux key-names (Space/Tab/Up/...). Leave play as ["Enter"] if you run with permissions on (Play then approves/submits).

events._comment: Claude Code hook event -> state. States: idle | working | needs | done.

sessions._mode_comment: single = one agent on LED 0 (or whole row); multi = up to 4, one Track LED each; cockpit = up to 8 (front 4 + side 4), Play-held shift to drive 5-8, Track = jump (tmux focus follows), Vol+ = next-needs-you, and the faders/autopilot below come alive.
sessions._assign_comment: PIN a session to a fixed LED. multi: 0-3. cockpit: 0-7. A KEY matches EITHER a tmux session NAME (exact) OR a project PATH (cwd is/under it). Use NAMES if you launch claude from one dir (e.g. home) in named tmux sessions; use PATHS if each session runs in its project dir. Others auto-fill the rest.

faders._comment: COCKPIT MODE ONLY. Which fader ix (0-3) does which job. scroll = absolute scroll position of the focused session; scrubber = sweep focus across all sessions; calm = board sensitivity (0 = only needs-you lit, full = all states); assign = fader 4, choose a preset.

assign._preset_comment: coarse = snap-scroll the focused session by deciles; autopilot = self-drive a stopped session (needs autopilot.enabled); rotate = a second scrubber; custom = fire 'action' (a key list / {shell}) at the top of the throw.

autopilot._comment: Fader-4 'autopilot' preset. OFF by default and ENFORCED: it only arms when enabled=true AND permission.enabled=false (dangerous-mode shape) AND input.backend='tmux' (needs an exact pane). Dialing the fader up arms the FOCUSED session: when it STOPS, the daemon auto-sends 'nudge' every steps_s[bucket] seconds to its exact pane. A real question (needs-you) pauses it (sticky through a following Stop); a pane-less session disarms; after 'deadman' hands-off continues it parks + hard-alerts (a held fader can't reset that, only your real prompt does).

input._comment: how a button press reaches your session: 'tmux' (default; precise, multi-session, no permissions, needs tmux), 'osascript' (macOS keystroke to the FOCUSED window; no tmux but needs Accessibility permission, can't target a specific session), or 'none' (lights only, works everywhere).

permission._comment: Approve/deny tool-permission prompts from the SP-1. When Claude WOULD prompt you (per YOUR OWN permission setup -- no imposed gate list), the session's LED blinks: Play = allow, Vol- = deny. After timeout_s with no press it falls through to the normal on-screen prompt. Never fires under 'claude -p'. enabled=false = lights only, decide on screen.
